name: Sword of the Elf Mother
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level cleric/oracle 3, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect one shimmering silver longsword
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A shimmering silver longsword appears in your hand. The longsword functions as a +1 silver longsword (+1 to attack, 1d8+1 damage), but does double damage vs. undead (2d8+2). You can wield the sword of the elf mother even if you do not possess proficiency in longsword.
